definitions.explanation: a quality of warmth or friendliness in one's manner; almost always used in the negative form 素っ気ない to mean cold, curt, or unfriendly

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{返事|へんじ}→返事：00844_henji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{素|そ}っ{気|け}なかった。
{素|そ}っ{気|け}ない⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}らないで→取る：00565_toru⟧ほしい。
examples.english: I wish you wouldn't act so cold toward me.

examples.japanese: ⟦{店員|てんいん}→店員：00897_tenin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{素|そ}っ{気|け}なく⟦{断|ことわ}られて→断る：02102_kotowaru⟧、⟦がっかりした→がっかりする：21758_gakkarisuru⟧。
examples.english: I was disappointed when the shop clerk curtly turned me down.

notes:
Almost exclusively used in the negative form {素|そ}っ{気|け}ない (curt, cold, unfriendly) or as the adverb {素|そ}っ{気|け}なく. The positive form {素|そ}っ{気|け} alone is rarely used. Describes a manner of speaking or behaving that lacks warmth or interest.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {素|そ}っ{気|け}ない⟦{返事|へんじ}→返事：00844_henji⟧: a curt reply
- {素|そ}っ{気|け}ない⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧: a cold attitude
- {素|そ}っ{気|け}なく⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧: to say curtly
- {素|そ}っ{気|け}なく⟦{断|ことわ}る→断る：02102_kotowaru⟧: to refuse coldly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{冷|つめ}たい→冷たい：00681_tsumetai⟧: cold — describes both personality and physical temperature; broader than {素|そ}っ{気|け}ない
- ⟦{愛想|あいそ}→愛想：12699_aiso⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: unfriendly — emphasizes lack of sociability or charm
- ⟦{無愛想|ぶあいそう}→無愛想：07294_buaisou⟧: brusque, unsociable — stronger than {素|そ}っ{気|け}ない, suggesting habitual unfriendliness
